references.title: A. Blokhuis, A. E. Brouwer, B. M. M. de Weger, Binomial collisions and near collisions, Integers 17 (2017) #A64
references.note: Theorem 2.2, case n ≤ 10^6, by the exhaustive search of §2.1 (every row up to a million, 56 CPU hours in 2017); earlier searches n ≤ 10^3 by de Weger 1997.

summary: Known by computation: Blokhuis, Brouwer and de Weger searched every row n ≤ 10^6 of the half triangle and found no collision beyond the eight sporadic quadruples and Lind's family (Theorem 2.2). A finite but large verification; a formalisation would be a certified computation, not a proof from the literature's argument.
